legend.agri.livestockFarmTitle: Livestock and poultry farms: main species
legend.agri.livestockSizeNote: Size + shade = total head count (more = larger and darker; relative within each species layer, not comparable across species)
legend.agri.manufacturingNote: 202608 registry snapshot; all points with coordinates are shown from the island-wide scale, without thinning or clustering. 184,944 records have coordinates; points are company registered addresses, not the factories' actual operating addresses.
legend.agri.filtersNote: Filters are set; the unfiltered overview grid is hidden. Zoom in to z12 to see the filtered companies.
legend.agri.overviewNote: 202608 registry snapshot; grid density at 1.5 km for z4–9 and 450 m for z10–11, with clickable individual companies from z12.
legend.agri.factoryDot: Registered factory points with publishable coordinates
legend.agri.factoryNote: 202606 snapshot; all points with coordinates are shown from the island-wide scale, without thinning or clustering. 90,652 / 100,624 records can be located.
legend.agri.regulatedDot: Ministry of Environment active regulated facilities
legend.agri.regulatedNote: 20260818 snapshot; all points with coordinates are shown from the island-wide scale, without thinning or clustering. 80,732 / 127,795 records have coordinates; regulated status is not an incident, a penalty or a risk level.
legend.agri.densityGridNote: z4–<10 uses a 1,500 m grid and z10+ uses a 450 m grid, switching automatically with zoom.
legend.agri.parkNote: v1 explicitly excludes science parks; the A3 member roster has no geometry and is not mixed in or used to infer park boundaries.
legend.agri.parkComparisonNote: Only observed entities with valid coordinates assigned to a park polygon are counted: 90,652 / 100,624 for A1 and 184,944 / 186,054 for manufacturing companies. 0 does not mean none actually exist. Science park membership is not mixed into this comparison.
legend.agri.gridNote: {scale} non-empty cells, 202608 registry snapshot; color steps run from low to high = value from low to high; fixed non-linear breaks for each scale.
legend.agri.indTotalDensity: Registered industries total density (companies per km²)
legend.agri.indTotalNote: 202608; total for the selected industries, each company counted once.
legend.agri.indTotalNoteFocus: 202608; total for the selected industries, each company counted once. Focus on a mid-level class takes precedence over groups.
legend.agri.indTotalNoteNone: 202608; total for the selected industries, each company counted once. No category selected; the layer is hidden.
legend.agri.indNoteFocus: Focused on a single mid-level industry class, which uses its group's color; this takes precedence over multi-selecting groups.
legend.agri.indNoteNone: No category selected; the layer is hidden.
legend.agri.indNoteMain: Color = the selected group with the most companies, which is not necessarily a majority; ties are marked separately. 202608 registry snapshot, not the actual main business.
legend.agri.ageMetricRecent: Share founded in the last 5 years (%)
legend.agri.ageNoteMedian: 202608 snapshot; median company age is about 2026 minus founding year.
legend.agri.ageNoteRecent: 202608 snapshot; share founded in the last 5 years (2022–2026); the denominator only includes valid known founding years. With fewer than 20 companies of known founding year, the share can be extreme.
legend.agri.commonSize: Size = number of companies registered together
legend.agri.commonNote: Showing addresses with ≥ {n} companies registered together; click to see total and median capital.
legend.agri.agriPoiTitle: Leisure farms / Tian Mama / featured agritourism
